special_instructions:
In order for Aether to complete Galaxy Map navigation cleanly, open Options -> General Controls -> Interface Mode and change UI Panel navigation keybinds:
  W -> Up Arrow
  S -> Down Arrow
  A -> Left Arrow
  D -> Right Arrow

*** This resolves the redundant default keybind conflict between UI Interface Mode and Galaxy Camera Controls. After changing these in-game, click 'Scan / Sync Keybinds' on the Controls & Extensions tab. ***

trigger_events.label: Charging Jump (StartJump)
trigger_events.description: Fires when initiating a hyperspace or supercruise jump.

trigger_events.label: Route Plotted (RoutePlotted)
trigger_events.description: Fires when a new destination star system is plotted in the Galaxy Map.

trigger_events.label: Arrived in New System (FSDJump)
trigger_events.description: Fires right after completing a hyperspace jump into a star system.

trigger_events.label: Entered Supercruise (SupercruiseEntry)
trigger_events.description: Fires upon entering supercruise.

trigger_events.label: Dropped from Supercruise (SupercruiseExit)
trigger_events.description: Fires when dropping into normal space.

trigger_events.label: Approaching Planet / Moon (ApproachBody)
trigger_events.description: Fires when entering orbital cruise near a body.

trigger_events.label: Leaving Planet / Moon (LeaveBody)
trigger_events.description: Fires when leaving orbital cruise around a body.

trigger_events.label: Landed on Surface (Touchdown)
trigger_events.description: Fires upon touching down on a planetary surface.

trigger_events.label: Lifted Off Surface (Liftoff)
trigger_events.description: Fires when taking off from a planetary surface.

trigger_events.label: Fuel Scooping (FuelScoop)
trigger_events.description: Fires when scooping fuel from a star.

trigger_events.label: Low Fuel Threshold (FuelLevel)
trigger_events.description: Fires when main fuel percentage drops below configured warning thresholds (e.g. <25% or <10%).

trigger_events.label: Neutron / White Dwarf Supercharge (JetConeBoost)
trigger_events.description: Fires when FSD is supercharged in a jet cone.

trigger_events.label: Docking Requested (DockingRequested)
trigger_events.description: Fires when transmitting a docking request.

trigger_events.label: Docking Clearance Granted (DockingGranted)
trigger_events.description: Fires when a station or carrier assigns a landing pad.

trigger_events.label: Docking Request Denied (DockingDenied)
trigger_events.description: Fires when docking clearance is denied.

trigger_events.label: Docked at Station / Carrier (Docked)
trigger_events.description: Fires upon landing and docking at a starport, outpost, settlement, or carrier.

trigger_events.label: Undocked from Pad (Undocked)
trigger_events.description: Fires when lifting off and undocking from a pad.

trigger_events.label: Ship Refueled (RefuelAll)
trigger_events.description: Fires when refueling at a station.

trigger_events.label: Ship Repaired (RepairAll)
trigger_events.description: Fires when repairing at a station.

trigger_events.label: Under Hostile Fire (UnderAttack)
trigger_events.description: Fires when your ship takes hostile fire.

trigger_events.label: Pulled Out by Interdiction (Interdicted)
trigger_events.description: Fires when pulled out of supercruise by an interdiction.

trigger_events.label: Evaded Interdiction (EscapeInterdiction)
trigger_events.description: Fires when successfully escaping an interdiction.

trigger_events.label: Shields Down / Restored (ShieldState)
trigger_events.description: Fires when shields drop or come back online.

trigger_events.label: Hull Taking Damage (HullDamage)
trigger_events.description: Fires when hull integrity drops across damage thresholds.

trigger_events.label: Heat Critical / >90% (HeatWarning)
trigger_events.description: Fires when ship thermal level reaches warning threshold (before heat damage).

trigger_events.label: Taking Thermal Damage (HeatDamage)
trigger_events.description: Fires when overheating causes module/hull damage.

trigger_events.label: Bounty Awarded / Kill Confirmed (Bounty)
trigger_events.description: Fires when destroying a wanted target.

trigger_events.label: Fighter Destroyed (FighterDestroyed)
trigger_events.description: Fires when your ship-launched fighter is destroyed.

trigger_events.label: Ship Destroyed (Died)
trigger_events.description: Fires upon ship destruction.

trigger_events.label: System Honk Completed (FSSDiscoveryScan)
trigger_events.description: Fires after completing a Discovery Scanner honk.

trigger_events.label: All System Bodies Found (FSSAllBodiesFound)
trigger_events.description: Fires when every body in the system has been scanned in FSS.

trigger_events.label: Body / Star Scanned (Scan)
trigger_events.description: Fires on detailed scan of a star or planet.

trigger_events.label: Surface Mapping Complete (SAAScanComplete)
trigger_events.description: Fires when finishing a DSS surface map of a body.

trigger_events.label: New Codex Discovery (CodexEntry)
trigger_events.description: Fires when discovering a new Codex entry.

trigger_events.label: Exobiology Sample Scanned (ScanOrganic)
trigger_events.description: Fires when scanning biological samples on foot.

trigger_events.label: Asteroid Prospected (ProspectedAsteroid)
trigger_events.description: Fires when a prospector limpet analyzes an asteroid.

trigger_events.label: Ore Refined (MiningRefined)
trigger_events.description: Fires when the refinery produces a ton of refined ore.

trigger_events.label: Cargo Collected (CollectCargo)
trigger_events.description: Fires when scooping or limpet-collecting cargo.

trigger_events.label: Mission Accepted (MissionAccepted)
trigger_events.description: Fires when accepting a new mission.

trigger_events.label: Mission Completed (MissionCompleted)
trigger_events.description: Fires when turning in a mission.

trigger_events.label: Mission Failed (MissionFailed)
trigger_events.description: Fires when a mission fails or expires.

trigger_events.label: Commodities Purchased (MarketBuy)
trigger_events.description: Fires when buying commodities at a market.

trigger_events.label: Commodities Sold (MarketSell)
trigger_events.description: Fires when selling commodities at a market.

trigger_events.label: Construction Delivery Made (ColonisationContribution)
trigger_events.description: Fires when delivering commodities to a colonisation construction depot.

trigger_events.label: Construction Depot Status Updated (ColonisationConstructionDepot)
trigger_events.description: Fires with live construction project progress and remaining material requirements.

trigger_events.label: Dropped into Signal Source (USSDrop)
trigger_events.description: Fires when dropping into a signal source.

trigger_events.label: Incoming Comms / NPC Hail (ReceiveText)
trigger_events.description: Fires when receiving an in-game message or pirate hail.

trigger_events.label: Carrier Jump Scheduled (CarrierJumpRequest)
trigger_events.description: Fires when scheduling a Fleet Carrier jump.

trigger_events.label: Carrier Arrived in System (CarrierJump)
trigger_events.description: Fires when your Fleet Carrier completes a jump.

trigger_events.label: SRV Deployed (LaunchSRV)
trigger_events.description: Fires when deploying the SRV from your ship.

trigger_events.label: SRV Boarded Ship (DockSRV)
trigger_events.description: Fires when docking the SRV back into your ship.

trigger_events.label: Disembarked on Foot (Disembark)
trigger_events.description: Fires when stepping out on foot.

trigger_events.label: Boarded Ship from Foot (Embark)
trigger_events.description: Fires when boarding your ship from on foot.

default_triggers.name: Auto Discovery Scan
default_triggers.description: Holds Secondary Fire (Right Mouse) for 5.8s after entering a new system. Edit to change the button/key to match your fire group.

default_triggers.name: Auto Deploy Weapons
default_triggers.description: Automatically deploys hardpoints when coming under fire if weapons are currently stowed.

default_triggers.name: Auto Refuel, Repair & Restock on Dock
default_triggers.description: In one fast pass after docking, moves to the Refuel icon and activates Refuel, Repair, and Restock in sequence using your synced UI keys (yields immediately if you move your mouse).
default_triggers.goal: On the station main menu, activate Refuel, Repair, and Restock in a single fast pass (move to Refuel once, then batch Select, UI Right, Select, UI Right, Select using synced UI keys; skip any that are already disabled/0 CR and stop immediately without closing the station menu)

default_triggers.name: Pre-Departure Best Trade Suggestion
default_triggers.action_label: Check Best Profitable Trade Before Undocking
default_triggers.description: When you plot a route while docked, checks live market prices between your current station and your destination system and suggests the top profitable commodity to load up on before you leave.

default_triggers.name: Scoopable Star Check on FSD Charge (KGBFOAM)
default_triggers.description: On FSD spin-up for a hyperspace jump, tells you the destination star class and whether it is fuel-scoopable (KGBFOAM).

default_triggers.name: Low Fuel Warning (<25%)
default_triggers.description: Warns you when your main fuel tank drops below 25%.
default_triggers.speak_text: Heads up — main fuel tank is below 25% ({fuel_pct}% remaining). Plan a scoopable star or refueling stop soon.

default_triggers.name: Critical Fuel Warning (<10%)
default_triggers.description: Delivers an urgent warning when your main fuel tank drops below 10%.
default_triggers.speak_text: Critical fuel warning — below 10% ({fuel_pct}% remaining)! Divert to a scoopable star or station immediately!

default_triggers.name: Auto Launch Heat Sink
default_triggers.description: Automatically deploys a heat sink when ship heat reaches critical warning threshold (12s cooldown to avoid double-firing).

default_triggers.name: Auto Lower Landing Gear on Clearance
default_triggers.description: Automatically lowers landing gear once docking clearance is granted.

default_triggers.name: Auto Retract Landing Gear on Undock
default_triggers.description: Automatically retracts landing gear 4 seconds after lifting off the pad.

default_triggers.name: Shields Down Tactical Callout
default_triggers.description: Delivers an immediate in-character warning when your shields collapse.
default_triggers.speak_text: Shields just dropped — watch your hull and take evasive maneuvers!

default_triggers.name: Neutron Supercharge Confirmation
default_triggers.description: Confirms when your FSD finishes supercharging in a neutron or white dwarf jet cone.
default_triggers.speak_text: FSD supercharged — jump range boosted, pull clear of the jet cone!

UI_Back.description: UI Back / Close Map or Menu

take us out.description: Select and activate Auto Launch (or Launch) on the station/carrier menu using synced UI keybinds + Vision verification
take us out.condition_skip_ack: We are not currently docked at a station or carrier.

steps.goal: Select and activate Auto Launch (or Launch if Auto Launch is unavailable) on the station or carrier services menu to undock

recall ship.description: Recall or dismiss your ship while in the SRV or on foot (uses synced RecallDismissShip bind)
recall ship.condition_skip_ack: You are already aboard your ship, Commander.

deploy srv.description: Deploy SRV from the Role/Bottom panel when landed in main ship (uses synced UI/panel keybinds)
deploy srv.condition_skip_ack: We need to be landed in our main ship to deploy the SRV.

steps.goal: Open the Role/Bottom panel, select the SRV bay, and select Deploy

board ship from srv.description: Board main ship from the SRV Role/Bottom panel (uses synced UI/panel keybinds)
board ship from srv.condition_skip_ack: You are not currently in an SRV.
board ship from srv.ack: Boarding the main ship from the SRV.

steps.goal: Open the Role/Bottom panel in the SRV and select Board Ship

disembark from ship.description: Disembark on foot from your docked or landed main ship via the Role/Bottom panel
disembark from ship.condition_skip_ack: We must be docked or landed before disembarking.
disembark from ship.ack: Disembarking on foot from the ship.

steps.goal: Open the Role/Bottom panel in the cockpit and select Disembark

disembark from srv.description: Disembark on foot from the SRV via the Role/Bottom panel
disembark from srv.condition_skip_ack: You are not currently in an SRV.
disembark from srv.ack: Disembarking on foot from the SRV.

steps.goal: Open the Role/Bottom panel in the SRV and select Disembark

state_shields_offline.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Shields just went offline! Warn the player immediately in 6 words.

state_overheating.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Thermal overload / overheating! Warn the player in 6 words.

state_being_interdicted.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Interdiction detected! Warn the player immediately in 6 words.

state_low_oxygen.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Suit oxygen critical! Warn the player in 6 words.

state_low_fuel.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Fuel reserves below 25%. Notify the player briefly.

state_mass_locked.prompt: Co-pilot alert: Frame Shift Drive is mass locked. Mention briefly.
